description: Source code for in-memory collection and metrics tracking of differences in a diffing system, including classes for counters, metadata, and a collector.

classes.name: InMemoryDifferenceCounter
classes.description: Tracks differences per endpoint and manages metadata counters.

classes.name: InMemoryFieldMetadata
classes.description: Stores metrics related to individual fields, such as differences and siblings count.

classes.name: InMemoryEndpointMetadata
classes.description: Maintains metrics for a specific endpoint, including total differences and individual field metadata.

classes.name: InMemoryDifferenceCollector
classes.description: Collects and manages difference results, supporting creation, prefix filtering, and clearing.

methods.name: endpointCollector
methods.description: Retrieves or creates endpoint metadata for a given endpoint.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves or creates field metadata for a given field.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds difference data to endpoint metrics and field metadata.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new DifferenceResult entry in the collector.

methods.name: prefix
methods.description: Returns difference results with fields starting with a given prefix.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Retrieves a DifferenceResult by its ID, throws exception if not found.
